task.description: Implement ISS-202: Two-phase (all-or-nothing) variable merge in src/engine/transition.zig. Depends on ISS-201 (transition() returns TransitionResult{state, emitted_events}). Phase 1: Validate ALL keys with no state change/events; on any failure, emit only EXECUTION_ERROR and leave variables untouched. Phase 2: Apply all keys and emit overwrites only when every key is valid. Retry after failure sees pre-merge state. Update all call sites. Write unit tests asserting emitted-event lists; integration test asserting atomic commit.
acceptance_criteria: Phase 1 validates all keys before any state change
Phase 2 applies keys only after Phase 1 succeeds
EXECUTION_ERROR emitted on any validation failure; no partial applies
Variables unchanged on failure; retry sees pre-merge state
Unit tests for mixed valid/invalid output (no overwrite events, instance ERROR, variables unchanged)
Integration test for atomic validation + apply
zig build exits 0; zig build test exits 0; error-set validation passes
